bars: Lemme tell ya 'bout our trip to Blackpool,
Last week we went, my mate and me,
B&Bs were cheap, but that's not the scoop,
Folks say the weather's shite - they're right!
Had fish n' chips at the arcade,
The missus cried, said she was tired,
I told her, 'Don't be such a knave,'
But she still moaned throughout the ride.
We went to the Pleasure Beach too,
Rides that spin like a washing machine,
She felt ill but didn't retch or boohoo,
Just clutched her stomach and looked green.
